svg.title: The best on HalfCheetah comes last everywhere else
svg.desc: A bump chart of 4 competitors across 4 periods from HalfCheetah to Swimmer, each a line at its rank with rank 1 at the top. Four algorithms ranked by mean return on each task, best at the top. DDPG, first on HalfCheetah, is last on the three other tasks; TRPO goes the opposite way.
svg.text: The best on HalfCheetah comes last everywhere else
Rank of four algorithms on four MuJoCo tasks · Henderson et al. (2018), table 3
Four algorithms ranked by mean return on each task, best at the top
DDPG, first on HalfCheetah, is last on the three other tasks; TRPO goes the opposite way.
